descriptionChirho: A civil or political leader exercising governing authority over a people or territory, translated as ruler, governor, or chief in a civic sense (Arabic رَئِيس, Hindi हाकिम, Swahili watawala/kiongozi).

A military or organizational leader who commands troops or directs operations, translated as commander, captain, or chief in a military sense (Arabic قَائِد, Hindi सरदार/सेनापति, Spanish capitán/comandante).
